fusions.name: Ridden Through
fusions.desc: A full-speed collision that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Thrown-Up Turf
fusions.desc: Your hooves throw up 3 clods of turf at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Open Ground
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Heart Keeps the Beat
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
